Adhikaar landing page, as it stands on localhost:3000.

Drag, retype, resize, restyle anything. The Type slider above each frame scales the whole page at once — that is the lever for the text-size question.

Tell me what you changed and I will put it into the real site.
The phone is the real device. PRODUCT.md: the reader is often standing at a bank counter, on a mid-range Android. Judge it on the left frame first.
